tiktok.caption:
I've been staring at this task for hours. ADHD freelancer edition. 🫠

I know exactly what the client wants. The brief is right there. It still feels like there's an invisible wall between me and the first click.

So I told FOCO about it. It broke the logo into four tiny steps. Step 1 was just opening the brief and highlighting three words. Two minutes, study sounds on, and I was in.

How long have you been staring today? 👇
Save this for the next time you're stuck 📌

You don't need another to-do list. You need help starting. The app on the slides is FOCO, link in bio 💜
